title: cheirodendron gaudichaudii
intro: Cheirodendron gaudichaudii, commonly known as the "Ti Plant" or "Poi", is a plant species native to French Polynesia and the Hawaiian Islands. It is a perennial plant with edible leaves that have been used for centuries in traditional medicine and cooking. The leaves of the Cheirodendron gaudichaudii plant are rich in vitamins and minerals, and have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
